entries.title: Fixed Four-Wheel Boarding Stair Cart
entries.description: One original fixed aviation ground-service boarding stair cart, counted as one complete prop. A single thick closed staircase flight has seven rising tread levels and one integral upper landing. Two independent thick full-length side frames each have a genuine six-sided through opening. Two transverse axles, four flat-ground polygonal wheels, one low front bearer and one full-height rear bearer support the complete flight. Eleven editable closed connected meshes and four constant opaque PBR materials. All geometry is newly authored, with no cargo tub, towing eye, tank, engine, copied ladder, spectator seating or old geometry imports. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, ground origin under the cart centre. One static visual pose and zero scenes. No aircraft, passengers, towing vehicle, terrain, texture, text or animation is included. No boarding access, human fit, fall protection, tread grip, railing performance, wheel or steering operation, towing, brakes, stability, loads, manufacture, installation, aviation suitability, safety certification or compatibility with existing aircraft is claimed.

entries.title: Notched-End Uncapping Trough
entries.description: One original empty beekeeping collection-table visual prop: a continuous long tapered rectangular catch basin with a real deep open cavity, complete thick closed bottom and broad upper rim; two raised opposing end rests each have a genuine open-top U notch with a finite flat floor. Four distinct straight legs meet the complete basin underside at finite top seats and stand on full flat ground soles. Seven closed connected editable meshes and four constant opaque untextured PBR materials. One fixed assembly counts as one prop, zero scenes. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontal envelope centred and ground Z=0. Newly authored basin, rests and legs; no old hive, sieve, tank, worktable, frame, cart or wash-station model is imported or modified. No frame, knife, wax, honey, liquid, outlet, sieve, wheels, lid, texture, animation or scene. The empty notches suggest a collection-workstation arrangement only: no fit for historical frames or hives, uncapping performance, liquid handling, food contact, sanitation, strength, structural load, anti-tip stability, manufacturing, equipment operation or safety certification is claimed.
